children: South Korea's national security adviser Wi Sung-lac said at a briefing on Wednesday that South Korean President Lee Jae-myung and U.S. President Donald Trump agreed to deepen cooperation on nuclear-powered submarines, uranium enrichment and reprocessing, and shipbuilding. According to Sina Finance, Lee and Trump held about a 30-minute meeting on Tuesday evening local time in New York.

title: South Korea Says Lee Jae-myung and Trump Agree to Deepen Cooperation on Nuclear Submarines and Shipbuilding
